setup.title: Setup instructions
setup.step1: Go to console.cloud.google.com. If you don't have a project, create one — any name works.
setup.step2: Go to APIs & Services → Library, search for Google Calendar API, and enable it.
setup.step3: Go to APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen. Choose External (or Internal if you have Google Workspace). Fill in the app name and your email, then save.
setup.step3Testing: While the app is in Testing, only Google accounts added as test users can connect, and Google caps this at 100 users. Once your team members are ready to connect their calendars, click Publish app to lift the limit (Internal / Workspace apps have no cap). See Google's guide.
setup.step4: Go to Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID. Set application type to Web application.
setup.step5: Under Authorised redirect URIs, add both redirect URLs shown below. Click Create. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret shown.
setup.step5Localhost: If you also run Calnode locally, add the http://localhost:3000/… variants of both URIs too.
setup.step6: Paste them into the form below and save.

oauth.subtitle: Enables Google sign-in and Google Calendar integration.

setup.title: Setup instructions
setup.step1: Go to the Zoom App Marketplace and sign in with your Zoom account. Click Develop → Build App.
setup.step2: Choose a General App (User-managed OAuth). While it is unpublished, Zoom only lets users inside the Zoom account that owns the app connect; hosts with their own separate Zoom accounts need a published app (see DEPLOY.md, "Zoom meeting links"). If that rules Zoom out, built-in video needs no Zoom app at all — see docs/VIDEO.md.
setup.step3: Under OAuth, set the Redirect URL for OAuth (and add it to the allow list) to the URL shown below.
setup.step4: Under Scopes, add meeting:write (create/update/delete meetings on the user's behalf).
setup.step5: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the app's Basic Information, paste them below, and save.

webhook.step1: 1. In LiveKit Cloud, open Project → Settings → Webhooks (docs).
webhook.step2: 2. Add a webhook with the URL above, and attach the same API key you entered here — it signs the events so Calnode can verify them.

storage.intro: Object storage is used in two places — database backups and meeting recordings. They share one bucket.

setup.title: Setup instructions
setup.step1: Create a bucket with any S3-compatible object storage provider — for example Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, or AWS S3. This is the same bucket both database backups and meeting recordings write to.
setup.step2: Generate an access key ID and secret access key for that bucket.
setup.step3: There's no form for this — set Litestream environment variables/secrets with your hosting provider, then redeploy.
setup.step3EndpointHint: For any provider other than AWS S3 (R2, B2, MinIO, etc.), also set LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT to that provider's S3-compatible endpoint URL. LITESTREAM_REGION is optional — only some providers need it.
setup.step4: Reload this page — once it shows Configured below, meeting recordings can be turned on beneath it.

invite.emailNotSetup: Email isn't set up, so bookers won't receive an invite. Add a sender in Settings → Email.
invite.onlineNoneWarning: This event type books an online meeting, so every booking has a join link, and Calnode will not send it to the booker. Pass its location_value from the booking.created webhook in your own confirmation.

confirmNone.title: Send the booker no invite at all?
confirmNone.description: Email is not set up in this workspace, so Calnode will not email the booker anything for this event type, and the host's calendar will not invite them either. The booker only hears from you if your own system sends the confirmation.

price.hint: Leave at 0 for a free event. A price sends bookers to Stripe Checkout before the slot is confirmed — requires Stripe to be connected.

scheduling.minNoticeHint: e.g. 60 = bookings must be 1h+ in future
scheduling.bookingWindowHint: How far ahead people can book. 0 = unlimited
scheduling.maxActiveHint: Upcoming bookings one attendee (by email) can hold. 0 = unlimited

hosts.intro: Who can host this event, and how meetings are staffed.
hosts.staffing: How should the meeting be staffed?

rr.priority: Priority — top of the list first

hosts.peopleHint: Pick who can take these bookings — add members individually or pull in a whole team.
hosts.rotateHint: One available person is booked per slot, spreading bookings across the group.
hosts.togetherHint: Everyone joins the same meeting. A slot is offered only when all required people are free.

rrHint.even: Spreads bookings evenly — whoever has the fewest upcoming meetings is booked.
rrHint.priority: The highest person in the list who's free is booked; fall down the list when they're busy.
rrHint.soonest: Offers the earliest slot anyone in the group has free.

hosts.rotationEmpty: Add people or a team to the rotation.
hosts.togetherEmpty: Add the people who attend this meeting.
hosts.requiredExplain: Required hosts always attend and must be free for a slot to open.
hosts.optionalExplain: Optional hosts join only when they're free — they never block a slot.

notifications.remindersHint: Send attendees a reminder email before the meeting. Defaults to 24 hours before if none are set.
notifications.customMessagesHint: Add an optional note appended to each email type.
notifications.subjectOptional: Subject line (optional — blank uses the default)
notifications.notePlaceholder: Add a custom note for attendees…
notifications.testSent: Test email sent to your inbox.
notifications.smtpNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured — configure it in Settings.
notifications.assistantGreetingHint: The chat assistant's opening line on this event's booking page. Leave blank to use the built-in greeting, which is automatically translated for the visitor's language; a custom greeting is shown exactly as written, in every language.
notifications.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! Tell me roughly when you'd like to meet…

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.hint: Choose a saved required host. The booking URL stays the same. Transfer is available only when there are no upcoming bookings. Calendar connections and global availability stay with each account.

validation.directoryOrder: Directory order must be a whole number.
validation.name: Name is required.
validation.duration: Duration must be at least 5 minutes.
validation.slotInterval: Slot interval must be at least 1 minute.
validation.maxActive: Max active bookings cannot be negative (0 = unlimited).
validation.rotation: Add at least one person to the rotation
validation.collective: Add at least one required host (someone who always attends)

questions.title: Intake Questions
questions.subtitle: Collect information from attendees when they book.
questions.label: Label
questions.optionsPlaceholder:

confirm.title: Remove question?
confirm.description: "{label}" will be removed from this event type's booking form.

validation.label: Label is required.
validation.options: At least one option is required for dropdown questions.
validation.optionsShort: At least one option is required.

embed.title: Embed
embed.subtitle: Drop this booking widget on your website — it renders inline, no iframe. Paste before </body>.

inline.label: Inline
inline.hint: Embeds the booking calendar directly in the page.

popup.label: Popup button
popup.hint: A button that opens the booking widget in a modal.

embed.footer: The widget calls this instance's public booking API. To restrict which sites may embed it, set EMBED_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
